modeled_vertical_claims.supported: Six levels total, one below grade, from WGI project page; cast-in-place structure per WGI.
modeled_vertical_claims.inferred: 3.2 m typical level interval, basement floor at -3.2m, grade at 0.0m, above-grade decks at 3.2m intervals, roof deck at 15.65-15.95m, parapet/screen top 17.1m.
modeled_vertical_claims.not_claimed: GIS vertical fields are not treated as surveyed heights because units/semantics are undocumented; exact built roof elevation remains uncertain.

roof_evidence.source: Indiana Geographic Information Office, Indiana Current Imagery ImageServer; archived crop in sources/current_aerial_harrison_crop.jpg and enlarged roof detail in roof_aerial_zoom.png.
roof_evidence.provider_date_range: The imagery service describes current orthophotography collected during 2022-2025; the specific image acquisition date is not exposed in the retrieved metadata.
roof_evidence.observed: The roof-level surface contains marked parking bays, drive aisles with directional arrows, and a raised elongated central structure/open-sided area, plus small rooftop enclosures near edges.
roof_evidence.model_response: Added approximate roof parking stall stripes, drive arrows, and an open-sided raised central pavilion canopy. These features are oriented to the GIS polygon principal axes and remain within the roof deck footprint. The existing main stair/service core is retained.
roof_evidence.limits: The aerial provides visual/top-down evidence only. Stall widths, exact layout coordinates, pavilion function, dimensions, height, circulation ramps, and edge enclosure details remain estimated; no dimensioned roof plan was found.

fa\u00e7ade_claims.supported: Open cast-in-place parking structure; brick veneer, architectural precast, and perimeter planter beds stated by project/contractor sources.
fa\u00e7ade_claims.inferred: Repeated open parking bays, pier rhythm, spandrel levels, stair/service core placement, and roof screen geometry are interpretive massing choices due lack of measured elevations.

reproducibility: Builder reads the archived raw GIS FID892 ring relative to its own project root; uses only Blender built-in Python/mathutils and creates local mesh/material data. The saved .blend has no external linked resources.
